 PS5 consoles are still in stock at Amazon ahead of 'GTA 6' launch day
 The big day is almost here. It's your last chance to prep. 
  By 
 Hannah Hoolihan 
 Hannah Hoolihan 
 Hannah Hoolihan is a freelance writer with Mashable. She’s written for various entertainment websites since 2017, covering everything from tech to games to film. You’ll currently find her work on IGN and Fangoria alongside Mashable, but she also has bylines at Rock Paper Shotgun, Collider, Screen Rant, and more. When she’s not writing, she enjoys catching up with the latest films and shows — horror, in particular — and has a deep love of FromSoft games, which she continues to happily replay.

 TL;DR: Both the digital and disc versions of the PlayStation 5 are in stock at Amazon, making now a perfect time to pick one up ahead of GTA 6 launch day.

 The release date for G rand Theft Auto 6 is Nov. 19 , so now is your last chance to upgrade your console ahead of launch. If you're shopping around for readily available stock, we've got good news: both the digital and disc models of the PlayStation 5 are in stock right now at Amazon .
 The digital model is priced at $599, while the disc model is available for $649. If you've been eager to grab one, now is a great time to act in case they sell out. Unfortunately, the PS5 Pro is already unavailable at Amazon.

 The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile 
 SEE ALSO: 
 'GTA 6' on PS5 vs. Xbox: What we know 
 Rockstar wrote in a statement that the game targets "30 frames per second" across both platforms, but PS5 users can enjoy "high-fidelity haptic feedback fully integrated across the game on DualSense controllers and adjustable via accessibility settings, improved spatial audio rendering so all in-game sounds take full advantage of Tempest 3D Audio, and improved load times". What better way to enjoy the wild world of Leonida, right?
 If you haven't preordered the game yet, check out our GTA 6 preorder guide for details on where it's available to buy right now ahead of its release and what editions there are to shop.
